pending_qa.q: What is the impact of missing the best years in the stock market on long-term investment returns?
pending_qa.r: If you invested $10,000 in the S&P 500 from 1987 to 2025, it would have turned into $616,000. If you missed the best five consecutive years, that $10,000 would have only turned into $175,000.

pending_qa.q: What percentage of the wealthiest Americans own real estate outside their primary residence?
pending_qa.r: According to the Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances, 69%, so 7 out of 10 of the wealthiest 10% of Americans own some form of real estate outside of their primary residence.

pending_qa.q: What proportion of the top 10% of wealthy Americans own their primary residence?
pending_qa.r: According to the Federal Reserve Survey and Consumer Finances, 95% of those top 10% of wealthy Americans do actually own their primary residence.

pending_qa.q: What percentage of wealthy people have equity in a business or own a business?
pending_qa.r: 48 percent of the top 10% of Americans have some sort of equity in a business for which they work or own a business.

pending_qa.q: How many businesses remain in operation ten years after their founding?
pending_qa.r: Two out of three businesses are no longer even in operation 10 years in the future.

pending_qa.q: How much more likely are millionaires to outsource tasks compared to the general population?
pending_qa.r: Millionaires were nearly three times as likely as the general population to outsource many of the tasks that they don't enjoy, like cutting their lawn or cleaning their house.

pending_qa.q: What percentage of millionaires attribute their wealth building to consistent investing via 401k accounts?
pending_qa.r: 80% of millionaires attribute to investing in their 401k, and 75% of the millionaires said regular, consistent investing over a long period of time was a big part of their success.

pending_qa.q: Over what typical timeframe does wealth creation occur for individuals entering the seven-figure net worth range?
pending_qa.r: Wealth creation is something that typically takes 27 to 29 years, with most people crossing into the seven figures when they are in their late 40s.
